== Title ==
<span lang="ja">スタン・モードで撃て</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">2フォース消費して 相手のキャラクターを1名対象に選ぶ。運命数を引く。運命数＞キャラクターの能力値なら、そのキャラクターは即座に相手の手札に戻る（そのキャラクターに配備されていたカードもすべて手札に戻る。）</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「……乗員をわしのもとにつれて来い。生きたままでだ！」 帝国軍の兵士たちは、捕虜を生け捕って尋問する必要がある場合、ブラスターをスタン（気絶） モードにセットする。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Set For Stun]].

'''Lore''' — "...Bring the crew to me. Alive!" Imperial soldiers set blasters to stun (unconscious) mode when they need to capture prisoners alive for interrogation.

'''Game text''' — Use 2 Force to choose one opponent's character as a target. Draw destiny. If destiny > the character's ability, that character immediately returns to the opponent's hand. All cards deployed on that character also return to hand.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore quotes bringing the crew alive and names stun (unconscious) mode. Game text returns attached cards to hand, not owners' hands. White border.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-setforstun.gif|Original English face]], [[Set For Stun]].</ref>
